body:
Fixes #6644, Fixes #7055, Fixes #7156
Part of #7341

PR A of the three-PR #7341 batch (A = protocol text, B = structure extraction, C = tooling). Two files: `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` (3013 → 3112 lines) and `.claude/agents/os-dev.md` (629 → 674 lines).

## Maintainer authorization (verbatim, untranslated — Guardrails `.claude/` tooling exception)

> 关于项目经理的技能,接受你的优化意见,并和前面两个优化任务集中处理。派发使用云卡片,用 Fable 5 模型

> 项目经理技能还需要考虑的是派任务时使用什么模型,也应该项目经理决定,最低下限 sonnet,最高可以 fable

> 比如 更新 项目经理技能 必须要使用 Fable 5

> 确认,M 及以上默认云卡,并进 #7341

(Maintainer, devx seat's chat session, 2026-08-10; recorded on #7341, its claim comment, and the item-10 scope-addition comment. #6644 L2's own approval: maintainer ruling of 2026-08-10 05:10Z on #6644, plus the L2 shape decision recorded in the 07:11Z claim comment there.)

## Per-item checklist (item | landing section | before | after)

| # | Item | Landing section | Before | After |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | #6644 L2 dev half | SKILL step 5 prompt template | template tail said "you wait for CI to converge before reporting either way" | new template clause: report at draft-PR time, gate status recorded honestly (in_progress included), ⛔ no idle-poll; optional per-card 「本单等 CI」 override slot |
| 2 | #6644 L2 PM half | SKILL step 7 first review bullet + 入队与落地 B flip-timer paragraph | bullet framed the PM read as "复核侧的对账" against the dev's own CI wait | bullet rewritten: report-before-green is the expected shape, the PM's gate-job-conclusion read is the only gate reader, red gates route to a patch round; flip-timer paragraph marked as L2's PM half; B-over-D evidence (#6041/#6906, deaths between work-done and report) cited |
| 3 | #6644 L2 role-file half (also closes #7156) | os-dev.md Definition of done + "Local verification scope" + "Terminating cleanly" | "Wait for CI to converge before you return the report" bullet; scope-⚠️ said the local-farm trade is sound because "you still wait for CI"; terminating-cleanly sequence included "the foreground CI-convergence read" | reporting bullet: report at draft-PR time, ⛔ never sleep/timer-wait/idle-poll CI (#7156's measured cost cited: ~43 min / 141→168 calls / 222k→260k tokens, zero progress), per-card override restores the old contract; scope-⚠️ re-anchored on the PM's convergence read; sequence updated |
| 4 | Report-channel unification (batch item 3) | os-dev.md intro + "Terminating cleanly"; SKILL step 6 (subagent, cloud, Routine boundary) | report existed only as the subagent return message; the issue-comment marker was cloud-mode-only | report lands twice, GitHub first (issue comment opening with the os-dev-report HTML-comment marker, read back after posting); return message demoted to accelerator; step-6 collection reads GitHub first in both modes |
| 5 | Role-file precedence (batch item 5) | SKILL step 5 sunk-clauses paragraph; os-dev.md "Standard clauses live HERE" | placement of standard clauses read as editorial | measured precedence rule written in (#7055: a verbatim per-dispatch prohibition lost to the role file); unconditional clauses live in os-dev.md and are fixed there; per-card variables go through explicit interfaces; devs surface prompt-vs-role-file conflicts instead of picking silently |
| 6 | Triage size/model suggestion (batch item 6) | SKILL step 2 audit-trail bullet; step 4 Container-and-model note; Model tiering tail | no triage-time model input existed | optional-but-recommended "Size/model suggestion" line in the classification comment; executor consumes it in the claim comment and may override with a stated reason; cannot lower the mandatory fable clause |
| 7 | Multi-account slimming (batch item 7) | SKILL step 4 intro | shared-identity rituals read as unconditional | same-account scope note: session-ID/tiebreaker rituals scoped to within-one-account; cross-account rule stays one line (assignee not yours ⇒ taken); ⛔ rituals kept, not deleted |
| 8 | Decision-card re-check commands (batch item 8) | SKILL step 8 points 1 and 3 | premise refresh required re-research | every premise line carries its own re-check command as a template requirement; analysis structure gains a premises slot |
| 9 | Model tiering rewrite (batch item 9) | SKILL step 5 "Model tiering" + claim-comment template + container-verdict examples | two tiers (sonnet/opus), 2026-08-09 authority | three tiers: floor sonnet (mechanical, gate-judged), default judgment tier opus, ceiling fable (claude-fable-5); mandatory claude-fable-5 for any card touching the PM skill, no discretion downward; the rulings above quoted verbatim as the authority block; resolution-order and env-var caveats kept unchanged; model recorded in the claim comment |
| 10 | M+ defaults to `mode:cloud` (scope addition, maintainer ruling of 2026-08-10, 「确认,M 及以上默认云卡,并进 #7341」) | SKILL Resource-limits sizing section + "Dispatch backends" + the Arguments `mode:` row | `mode:subagent` was the stated default ("Prefer this mode"); `mode:cloud` was a heavy-card exception behind a criteria list | M and above default to `mode:cloud` single-card dispatch; only S-grade mechanical cards stay `mode:subagent`; the old criteria list becomes examples of the M+ class, not the trigger list; the three companion disciplines (subscribe on creation, issue-comment report authority, archive_session at terminal state) named beside the default |
| 11 | #7055 cleanup prescription | os-dev.md resource rule 4 | "git worktree remove --force" prescribed unconditionally | delete node_modules first, then unforced git worktree remove; a refusal then means uncommitted work — stop and read git status before considering the flag; cleanup stated as a step of the task |

`git diff --stat` corresponds 1:1: exactly the two files above, nothing else.

## Declared readings

- **Dogfood SKILL's qualified `--force` left as-is** (`.claude/skills/dogfood-verification/SKILL.md` §5): the tree it removes is a throwaway under `/tmp` whose commit is already pushed, and the force exists to unlock the local branch for `--delete-branch` — the #7055 hazard (clobbering a parallel agent's live worktree) does not apply to that path. Named here so the sweep visibly did not silently change it.
- **#7156 closure**: fixed at the role-file layer per its own comment thread's evidence (a per-dispatch prohibition demonstrably loses to the role file), not via per-prompt lines. The L2 clause plus the reporting-item cost citation close it; no separate reporting-section line was needed beyond that citation.
- The three-axis escalation frame (guarded by `check:skill-frame-sync`) was deliberately left byte-untouched in both files.
- Item 10 landed as a follow-up commit (`89e57ad`) after the scope-addition comment arrived mid-batch; it propagated cleanly into PRs B and C (their SKILL.md counts moved to 3,011 and 3,016 respectively, ratchet still green).
